chunks: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
They mentioned in his presence the eclipse of the moon and the hardship that people experience from its severity, so he عليه السلام said: “If a part of it has cleared, then it has cleared.”

key_terms.الْقَمَرِ: the moon, the celestial body under discussion
key_terms.انْجَلَى: became clear or uncovered after being obscured
key_terms.انْكِسَافَ: eclipse, specifically the obscuring of the moon here
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: a part or portion, indicating partial clearing
key_terms.شِدَّتِهِ: its severity or intensity, referring to the hardship associated with the eclipse

ai.seo_question: In a lunar eclipse, when is it considered to have cleared according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a ruling-related statement from Imam Abu Abdillah Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning the lunar eclipse. It indicates that once part of the moon becomes clear again, that is treated as the clearing of the eclipse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1532 - Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that during a discussion about the eclipse of the moon and the hardship that people endure because of it,
He (Imam Al-Sadiq) said: "If a part of it (the moon) has cleared, then it has cleared”.
